अयम् दुःखव्रातव्रतपरिगमे पारणविधिर् महासौख्यासारप्रसरणरसे दुर्दिनम् इदम्
यद् अन्यन्यक्कृत्या विषमविशिखप्लोषणगुरोर् विभोः स्तोत्रे शश्वत् प्रतिफलति चेतो गतभयम्
ayaṃ duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam |
yad anyanyakkṛtyā viṣamaviśikhaploṣaṇaguror vibhoḥ stotre śaśvat pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam ||
## kram-p01–p05 — the hymn's purpose and the self's nature This hymn is the course of great ease: in the midst of the host of sorrows, the rite of completion, the essence of great bliss flowing, this inauspicious day. Constantly, on the worshipper's conduct, reflecting, it reflects back; the mind, fear-gone, in the hymn. Examining own self, examining again the hymned conduct, the worshipper in hymn-practice without effort; the examined self, in all-knowable-moment, that thus in hymn I, here, always, without effort. Ungrasped, own self is never knower of thing-knowledge; ungrasped, own self indeed is not. Śiva is that self, shining, all-thing-one-sap; hence I in hymn with devoted heart always blissful. By varied birth-etc.-wandering-course-garments, omniscience gained in heart; that inside, teaching-spread-course-become light, clearly in speech obtained, now I hymn without effort. Shaking off bond-abiding-conceit, enjoying varied things, by great fire of hymn-hutāśana, burned difference; varied self-splendor-rush, drinking things, varada, maddened, blissful. The hymn's purpose: by self-examination and hymn-practice, fear is removed, omniscience gained, difference burned, and bliss arises.

## kram-p11–p15 — the ground, the course, and the body Hence varied-varied-course-station-other-distinction-etc.-standing-thing-enjoying-power, Lord's power, always goes, no difference how. That in this ground (akula), Bhairava, your pada — that one-pointed become my heart-ground, Bhairava Lord. In measure, dissolved, Śiva-pada-shining-power-vaibhava-force, body-breath-and-rest limited-made-agentness-standing; when time-condition, dissolution-state approaches you — then goddess, which, shining, my, she be Śiva-made. Formerly creation dissolved, fire-formed, which there would shine, beyond-rush-facing, moon-touch-lovely; fire-moon-splendor-both-glory, Bhairava Lord, this creation-named, my mind, always shining.

## kram-p16–p20 — dissolution and the three powers Released, things-portion, outside extreme tasteless, when there you, by rush, raktimayatā; then red goddess, your all-things, indeed me, by action-raktāpāna-course-made gathering, make red. Outside-conduct abandoning, consciousness-ground dwelling, to dwell, when things-difference showing, waveless, stability-lost; of maintenance dissolution, goddess, your, maintenance-of-saṃsāra, my, always dissolve. World-dissolution wishing, by own-rush, own-doubt-fear-named procedure then prohibition teaching; Yama created thus, then again doubt dissolving, great-goddess, that my world-fear she dissolve. Dissolved doubt-mass, instantly, full, Lord, power, all-knowable-host swallowing, by enjoyment-rush, Bhairava, dissolution-named, my heart, difference-portion, strike. Thus by goddesses, instantly, difference-power melted, thought-life-breath, shining, mother-standing, enough; hence dissolution-portion, own-heart reflected, standing, blissful, she be, goddess, my, death-dissolution-maker.
